description: Clean-room 3D solid modelling kernel (Parasolid / ACIS class): primitives (box, cylinder, sphere, cone, torus), affine transforms, extrusion of closed profiles, revolution, and regularised booleans (union/intersection/difference); must report exact mass properties and export a watertight STL. Graded against OpenCASCADE on hidden models by mass properties, by exact topology (watertightness + Euler characteristic) and by point-membership classification on hidden query points.
source: hidden models built with OCP (OpenCASCADE); references are its exact analytic mass properties and solid classifier
